title: Wasn't Expecting That
originalLines: It was only a smile but my heart it went wild
I wasn't expecting that
Just a delicate kiss, anyone could've missed
I wasn't expecting that
Did I misread the sign?
Your hand slipped into mine
I wasn't expecting that
You spent the night in my bed,
You woke up and you said
"Well, I wasn't expecting that"
I thought love wasn't meant to last,
I thought you were just passing through
If I ever get the nerve to ask
What did I get right to deserve somebody like you?
I wasn't expecting that
It was only a word, it was almost mis-heard
I wasn't expecting that
But it came without fear,
A month turned into a year
I wasn't expecting that
I thought love wasn't meant to last,
Honey, I thought you were just passing through
If I ever get the nerve to ask
What did I get right to deserve somebody like you?
I wasn't expecting that
Isn't it strange how a life can be changed
In the flicker of the sweetest smile
We were married in spring
You know I wouldn't change a thing
Without that innocent kiss, what a life I'd have missed
If you'd not took a chance on a little romance
When I wasn't expecting that
Time doesn't take long, three kids up and gone
I wasn't expecting that
When the nurses they came, said it's come back again
I wasn't expecting that
Then you closed your eyes, you took my heart by surprise
I wasn't expecting that!
parodyLines: Some old code, a few lines, an entire pipeline
I’ll Bioconductor that
A famous database, a complex dataset
I’ll Bioconductor that
Did I run all the tests?
Did I skip an OS?
Let the BBS check that
A few bugs that I missed,
A warning I dismissed
Thank BiocCheck for that
I thought code ran everywhere,
The same way it runs locally
If I ever get the nerve to ask:
Why did my review take four weeks rather than two?
Don’t ask Bioconductor that.
It was only an hour, volunteered here and there
I gave Bioconductor back
First I helped, then I chaired
’cause I liked and I cared
If I ever get the nerve to ask
Can I version bump my own package, every six month thank you?
Don’t ask Bioconductor that
Isn’t it great, how careers can be made
We all release in spring
It’s true we break a few things
With a deprecat’ risk, watch how fast it’s all fixed
